D. None of the above. - If A, B, C are all wrong, then D is correct.

Thus A false, B false, C false, so D is correct.

Let me look at the green light. The green light is on, indicating it's on/ready. So C false.

Water container: The clear tank on the right side looks empty or low. Not full. So B false.

Therefore D.

The answer should be just the letter.
